text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original checks in the same order with identical short-circuit semantics (`IsSenderCall` adds a `k > 0` guard that is harmless because that loop starts at `body.Start + 1`). The `StatementIsAllowed` early return preserves the `statementStart` gating, so behaviour is unchanged. The remaining method is a small loop with a few `||` conditions, well under 15, and I see no unused variables or other warnings that would break a warnings-as-errors build.
